description: Ten global band powers averaged on regions named in the AES introductory atlas (Britton et al. 2016), mapped onto this 32-channel cap. The atlas does not publish these electrode tuples. Derived measures stay on current_v1. Not confirmatory. Cleaning stays full-montage. Hz edges stay Angela/Zheng/Cochran.

provenance.source: Britton JW, Frey LC, Hopp JL, et al. Electroencephalography (EEG): An Introductory Text and Atlas of Normal and Abnormal Findings in Adults, Children, and Infants. St. Louis EK, Frey LC, eds. Chicago: American Epilepsy Society; 2016. doi:10.5698/978-0-9979756-0-4.
chapters: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK390342/ (An orderly approach…; band names and 10-20 letters)
provenance.what_the_atlas_says: α posteriorly dominant, occipital generator. β fronto-centro-temporal / precentral. θ/δ in wakefulness occasional; drowsy bursts frontally dominant; vertex waves fronto-central. γ not commonly encountered on scalp EEG.
provenance.what_this_file_does: Maps those region words onto classic 10-20 sites recorded here. This mapping is ours. Do not cite the atlas as if it listed these electrodes.
provenance.not_used: George nine-site montage and Wang left C/P/T theta. Do not mix.

cleaning.note: Do not subset channels before notch, average reference, interpolation, or ICA.
